blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution panel presented several bank accounts belonging to Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, Manases Carpio before the Senate impeachment court as it continued its attempt to uncover her alleged unexplained wealth. From Tuesday to Wednesday, the prosecution invited representatives of several banks, particularly LandBank, Asia United Bank (AUB), Philippine Savings Bank, Metrobank, Security Bank, the Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) Philippine National Bank (PNB) and Banco de Oro (BDO). Each financial institution presented bank accounts either owned respectively by Duterte and Carpio or jointly with other family members. READ: Sara Duterte’s joint deposits […]...
